mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals a weak labor market and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST > 750) and real consumption (RSAFS > 400000) signals robust consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST > 750 and RSAFS > 400000, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In an industrial contraction phase (INDPRO < 100), declining manufacturing output signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST > 750) signals strong consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 750, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation level (CPIAUCSL > 225) signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS > 133000) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE < 8.0%) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 133000 and UNRATE < 8.0%, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In an industrial expansion phase (INDPRO > 100), rising manufacturing output signals economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
